description: Inspect IEEE 754 float32/float64: sign, exponent and mantissa bits, hex, the exact stored value and the rounding error. Operations: "inspect" — Read a decimal (0.1, -2.5e-8, Infinity, NaN) or a bit pattern (0x3DCCCCCD, 32 or 64 binary digits) and show how float32 and float64 store it.. Call with "operation" plus "input" (and "options" where relevant).

input.description: A decimal number, Infinity/NaN, 0x + 8 or 16 hex digits, or 32/64 bits.

operation.description: inspect — Read a decimal (0.1, -2.5e-8, Infinity, NaN) or a bit pattern (0x3DCCCCCD, 32 or 64 binary digits) and show how float32 and float64 store it.

options.description: Options for the chosen operation (each says which operations use it).

format.description: Which binary format(s) to show. Used by: inspect.

name: ieee754
title: IEEE 754 Float Inspector
